name: Fuzzy Text
description: Canvas-rendered text with a fuzzy, glitchy scanline distortion that intensifies on hover, click, or on a timer, with optional gradient fill, RGB color split, and intro burst.
contents: Single canvas element drawing the children text as a distorted image
Offscreen source, scratch and per-channel canvases used for slicing and color split
behavior: Text is drawn to canvas and redrawn in slices shifted randomly, giving a fuzz effect at base intensity
Intensity rises to hoverIntensity while the pointer is over the text pixels, depending on trigger
Click mode fires a short decaying burst; clickEffect flashes full intensity for 150ms
Glitch mode periodically spikes intensity to full for glitchDuration every glitchInterval
Intro fades in and settles from a strong fuzz over introDuration
Optional RGB color split with additive or multiply blending depending on text brightness
Animation pauses when offscreen and rebuilds on font size or pixel ratio change
With reduced motion, base fuzz is zero, intro and glitch are skipped
editableByProps: Text content via children, font size, weight, family, letter spacing
Fuzz strength, range, slice size, frame rate and easing duration
Trigger mode (hover, click, always), hover enable, click flash
Glitch mode timing, intro animation, RGB color split

needsCodeEdit.change: Change click burst speed or length
Change the canvas pixel ratio cap

fixed: Renders to canvas with role img and aria-label of the text, so text is not selectable and children must be plain text
Canvas size is measured from the text, so it does not wrap; long text can overflow narrow screens unless fontSize is reduced
Pointer hover only registers over the drawn text pixels, not the whole canvas
Inherits text color and font from CSS when color is currentColor and fontFamily is inherit
Canvas gets a pointer cursor in click trigger mode
Waits for the font to load before first draw

options.look: Horizontal slices of the text shift sideways like a scanline glitch
options.useWhen: Hero headline or 404 page title needing a classic CRT glitch look

options.look: Vertical slices shift up and down, giving a wavering melt look
options.useWhen: Poster-style banner or section title that should look unstable and dripping

options.look: Slices shift on both axes for a heavily scrambled look
options.useWhen: Loud call-to-action or error screen where the text should look strongly corrupted
